page.overview:
What is Edgedancer?

Edgedancer is a fantasy novella, written by American author Brandon Sanderson. It was originally pthumbublished in 2016 in his novella and short story compendium Arcanum Unbounded:  The Cosmere Collection. It's part of the Stormlight Archive series.
